commanders: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin

strategy.primary: cEDH hand attack: repeat Kefka's enter/attack trigger (haste via Anger or Arena of Glory, Harmonic Prodigy, blink, clones, Gogo, Saw in Half) so every player discards while you draw per card type, then win with Thassa's Oracle or Underworld Breach.
strategy.secondary: Discard payoffs (Waste Not, Tinybones) and opposing life loss on your turn for the Ruler of Ruin face; Final Fortune for an extra Kefka turn.
